decision.explanation: Each of these values corresponds to the population of a distinct Licking Township according to the original sources. '7,899' refers to Licking Township, Blackford County, Indiana (2010 census). '7,723' refers to the same township as of 1 April 2020. '3,870' refers to Licking Township, Licking County, Ohio (2000 census). '536' refers to Licking Township, Clarion County, Pennsylvania (2010 census). These are separate geographic entities and thus their populations are distinct and valid.
